business_problem: Interclínica utilized Looker’s conversational analytics API to create "SofIA," an AI agent that eliminates "cognitive friction" by allowing leaders to access complex healthcare KPIs through natural language. This transformation turned a manual, days-long reporting process into a minutes-long conversation, driving radical efficiency and better patient care.
solution_summary: The implementation began with a low-cost pilot using Looker Studio and BigQuery, which allowed the team to prove value within just six months. This success paved the way for a more robust infrastructure using Dataflow and Cloud Composer to centralize data in BigQuery. By moving to the Looker platform, Interclínica didn't just buy a dashboarding tool; they invested in a data strategy designed to support their 2024 vision of becoming an AI-driven healthcare network. We realized our industry is changing, and we need to change with it. That’s why we need Google Cloud. Using Looker's conversational analytics API, we've moved from analysis in days to analysis in minutes, achieving the radical velocity needed to provide affordable healthcare.
